name: Investment Return Calculator
summary: Calculates total gain, ROI, annualised return over a stated holding period, and cash-on-cash return for an investment.
description: Calculates the total gain and ROI on an investment from what you put in, what it is worth now and cash received along the way; the annualised return over the holding period you state; and the cash-on-cash return from annual pre-tax cash flow. The period and assumptions are shown with the results. Who it's for: founders, finance leads and investors comparing an investment, project or property against alternatives. Limitations: annualised return assumes all cash arrives at the end (it is not an IRR) and is only calculated when you give a holding period; no taxes, fees or inflation unless already in your figures.
problems: What return did this investment make
I need the ROI and annualized return on a project
Compare cash-on-cash returns on a property

inputs.label: Ending value
inputs.description: What the investment is worth now or at exit.

inputs.label: Cash received
inputs.description: Dividends, distributions or rent received during the holding period.

inputs.label: Holding period (years)
inputs.description: How long the investment was held.

inputs.label: Cash invested (equity)
inputs.description: If different from the initial investment, e.g. with a loan.

outputs.label: Calculated results
outputs.description: Results with units, formulas, assumptions and warnings, from the registered calculation.

outputs.label: Explanation

execution.system: You are an analyst explaining calculated results to a business decision-maker. Be concrete and brief.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what the results mean for the decision, using only calculated numbers.
summary.title: Summary

text.description: One point. Numbers only from the calculated results.

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Runs the registered investment_return@1 calculation. All numbers in the result come from here.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Explains the calculated results; adds no numbers of its own.
steps.prompt: Explain the return in plain terms, how the annualised figure differs from total ROI, and what it leaves out. Mention every warning.

steps.name: Check explanation
steps.responsibility: Every number in the explanation matches the calculated results or your inputs.
